# scm_dlp_config_export_job (Data Source)

Reads the status and download URL of an Enterprise DLP configuration export job (/v1/api/configuration/export/job/{id}).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the status (and download link, once completed) of a config export job.
data "scm_dlp_config_export_job" "latest" {
  export_job_id = "REPLACE_WITH_JOB_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `export_job_id` (String) Configuration export job ID.

### Read-Only

- `download_url` (String) Download URL when the export job is completed.
- `export_type` (String) Export job type.
- `result_json` (String) Raw JSON response from GET /v1/api/configuration/export/job/{id}.
- `status` (String) Export job status (e.g. completed, cancelled, failed, in_progress).
- `tfid` (String) Terraform ID.
